stem: Redwood Bio runs two workloads: short event handlers and long-running container jobs that exceed 15 minutes, and the team wants the lowest-cost fit for bursty short handlers while avoiding server management. (Select TWO.)

choices.text: AWS Lambda for the short event handlers
AWS Lambda for the long-running container jobs
AWS Fargate for the short event handlers
AWS Fargate tasks for the long-running container jobs
Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group for the long-running container jobs

rationale: Lambda matches short event-handler execution patterns, and Fargate supports long-running containers without server patch management. Lambda is not the right fit for long-running container jobs that exceed standard function duration limits. Using Fargate for short event handlers can work technically, but it is not the lowest-cost fit for bursty short handlers compared with Lambda request-and-duration billing. EC2 Auto Scaling can run the jobs but reintroduces host management that the scenario explicitly wants to avoid.
